scenarios.title: Direct Simple cold-open requalifies after owner hydration

linkedTests.testTitle: BUG-004 SCN-B004-A: direct Simple cold-open requalifies after owner hydration without a mode change
TP-15-02 the production bridge reaches the SAME projection as the explicit runtime path for every module-backed wired tool (and the honest generic unavailable where the module is deliberately absent)

plannedRegressions.testTitle: BUG-004 SCN-B004-A: direct Simple cold-open requalifies after owner hydration without a mode change
plannedRegressions.command: npx --no-install playwright test tests/market-heatmap-control-surface.spec.mjs --config=playwright.config.mjs --project=system-chrome --grep "^BUG-004 SCN-B004-A: direct Simple cold-open requalifies after owner hydration without a mode change$" --reporter=list
plannedRegressions.classification: e2e-ui real local page and same-origin static server with request and view-event observation only
plannedRegressions.discriminator: The test never leaves Simple. Production accepts the terminal owner snapshot, so a panel that remains unavailable is stale rather than honestly insufficient.

expectedAssertions: the initial Simple projection is honestly unavailable
terminal hydration reaches 135 priced constituents
the panel becomes ready automatically without a mode change
the adapter is simple-adapter/market-breadth/v1
the current shell view remains Simple

scenarios.title: Ready Simple applies all five production registry controls

linkedTests.testTitle: BUG-004 SCN-B004-B: ready Simple applies all five registry controls with owner parity and zero post-hydration requests
TP-15-03 market-heatmap Simple renders real steerable controls and actuating one recomputes the production projection with no refetch

plannedRegressions.testTitle: BUG-004 SCN-B004-B: ready Simple applies all five registry controls with owner parity and zero post-hydration requests
plannedRegressions.command: npx --no-install playwright test tests/market-heatmap-control-surface.spec.mjs --config=playwright.config.mjs --project=system-chrome --grep "^BUG-004 SCN-B004-B: ready Simple applies all five registry controls with owner parity and zero post-hydration requests$" --reporter=list
plannedRegressions.classification: e2e-ui real local page and same-origin static server with request observation only
plannedRegressions.discriminator: The control set is registry-derived and every declared control must be actuated. Each rendered projection is compared with production runtime output over the same owner snapshot, so static relabeling or testing only window cannot pass.

expectedAssertions: window, grouping, size-metric, breadth-threshold, and outlier-sigma each expose their registry-declared accessible control
every declared control changes its model input and rendered production projection
each result equals production runtime output over the same owner snapshot
the request ledger remains empty after hydration
local commit 2f65a02a is preserved without a deployment claim

scenarios.title: Shared refresh and owner reuse are bounded and latest-result-wins

linkedTests.testTitle: requestSimpleRefresh filters wrong tool, non-Simple, non-ordinary, and invalidates work when leaving Simple
requestSimpleRefresh coalesces pre-start duplicates and retains only the latest pending successor
requestSimpleRefresh commits only the latest generation and preserves current-generation control ordering
requestSimpleRefresh renders current failure unavailable and suppresses stale failure
TP-15-02 owner parity: every wired tool's Simple facts EQUAL the owner/Power-path values

expectedAssertions: only the exact current ordinary tool in current Simple reads its provider
pre-start duplicates coalesce into one provider read
one active run retains only the latest pending successor
stale ready and unavailable completions perform no panel mutation
current controls remain ordered by runSequence
one boot union serves sector and constituent grouping
all Simple and Power levers reuse owner evidence and emit no acquisition request
the coordinator has no network, storage, cookie, beacon, publication, author, or focus-class authority
